answer.rationale: Run a guarded activation-messaging test for price-sensitive SMB accounts to reinforce time-to-value and meaningful product use without immediately sacrificing price or retention. Prior evidence confirms engagement and activation gains, while promotional pricing produced a material 30-day retention decline. Referral incentives are attractive for established customers but are less directly responsive to the current churn threat. Measure activation, qualified revenue, churn, and 30-day retention before scaling.
